agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Rogers diffusion evidence, application and peer scope, bounded organizational timing

analytical_question: How far have the defined technology and chart-review application diffused, what most accelerates or inhibits spread, and what timing implication follows for this organization without making the final adoption decision?
general_et_finding: INSUFFICIENT CURRENT EVIDENCE. The closed packet supplies only an undated vendor assertion. Its geography, sample, denominator, technology definition and actual-use status are absent. Withhold current diffusion stage, Rogers-category allocation and chasm/forecast claims; do not import S1-S3 observations from other cases.
application_finding: Exact chart-review peer diffusion is UNKNOWN. The five Rogers factors remain questions: relative advantage versus manual/rule-based review; compatibility with permissions and report ownership; complexity of connectors and exception review; trialability with authorized public/synthetic data; observability of repeated verified outcomes. These analytical questions supply no adoption rate.
organization_specific_finding: For this hypothetical conservative firm, begin by obtaining dated comparable evidence and clarifying the use definition. Permission restrictions remain. A numerical or category-based timing inference cannot be supported from the vendor assertion.

evidence.claim: The supplied undated vendor assertion lacks the metadata needed to measure diffusion.
evidence.notes: Not accepted as evidence of actual deployment. Rogers concepts are analytical questions, not new observations.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The closed probe intentionally omits the current source packet. No claim of population non-adoption follows from missing evidence.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that the closed packet is insufficient; low confidence in any current stage or penetration claim.
value_opportunity_implication: A transferable learning advantage is possible if source-linked correctness and full review effort improve against manual and simpler deterministic checks. Ecosystem complements may reduce integration friction, but this mechanism is inference, not measured local ROI.
risk_governance_implication: Popularity and social proof cannot authorize data access or publication. Maintain read-only boundaries and a named human report owner. Protocol availability does not certify a connector; unsuccessful trials or excessive review burden can justify stopping.
recommendation_management_implication: Obtain a dated original source and comparable peer-use definition before using diffusion to change timing. Preserve existing permissions and route any independent practical trial decision to Adoption.
change_monitoring_triggers: A proposed reporting owner obtains dated, comparable evidence of the exact workflow in similar firms, with population, geography, use definition and repeat-use status.
An authorized owner supplies quality-adjusted comparison results including review, correction, connector and exception costs; worsening errors or maintenance burden can delay or end work.
Data-environment permission or support capacity changes; reassess at the end of the four-week evidence window and within the twelve-month horizon, without a promised takeoff date.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request a defined peer denominator and comparable repeated chart-review deployments before assigning penetration or a majority/chasm label.
Request a local comparator and approved environment before making claims about realized advantage or internal rollout timing.
